_note: Scored experiments of the hardened gym. 'results' hold this gym's reference values on the hidden test (reference method = proposers/hageo.sh). The paper's reported numbers are kept unchanged under experiments.hageo409_aux._paper_reported.

hageo409_aux.description: Held-out HAGeo-409 problems whose premises DDAR alone saturates without proving the goal: fraction proved by DDAR after adding the submitted auxiliary constructions, within 16 attempts of at most 3 auxiliary points each, every attempt verified by the evaluator.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of held-out problems proved within the attempt budget (pass@16), as verified by the evaluator's DDAR.

hard_solve_rate.description: pass@16 on the problems with human difficulty >= 3 (the paper's bands [3,4) and above).

pass_auc.description: Mean over k=1..16 of pass@k: rewards proving problems with fewer attempts (the paper's Pass@K curves).

_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (unchanged). The gym is scaled: AlphaGeometry's public DDAR instead of the paper's optimized engine, attempt budget K=16 with at most 3 auxiliary points per attempt instead of K=2048/8192 with N=6, per-attempt CPU limits of 6-20 s instead of 60 s, and only problems whose premises DDAR alone saturates without reaching the goal. These numbers are therefore not on the gym's scale and are not targets.

auxiliary_core.description: Scaled sanity case for auxiliary construction: DDAR alone fails, while a CPU-only auxiliary construction enables proof.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of benchmark problems solved by the submitted method.

solved_count.description: Number of benchmark problems solved; included to make tiny-slice changes visible.

problem_count.description: Number of scored problems, reported for denominator auditing rather than optimization.

mean_attempt_index.description: Average successful or terminal attempt index; lower values indicate less search needed.

mean_auxiliary_count.description: Average number of auxiliary clauses emitted per problem, penalizing bloated constructions.

attempt_budget.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-attempt budget, a machine-independent search cost constraint.

rounds.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-construction rounds, penalizing larger search procedures.

timeout_seconds.description: Declared per-problem timeout budget, used as a resource cap rather than a wall-clock speed score.

neural_inference_used.description: Whether neural proposal inference was used; the paper's core constraint is CPU-only non-neural search.

hageo409_low_difficulty.description: HAGeo-409 low-difficulty-band comparison against the paper's [1,3) Random@2048 baseline and HAGeo@2048 rates (Table 1); reproduced runs use a fixed smaller slice from the same band and a documented smaller budget.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of low-difficulty HAGeo-409 problems solved by the submitted method.

solved_count.description: Number of low-difficulty HAGeo-409 problems solved, preserving count-level visibility on small slices.

problem_count.description: Number of scored problems, reported for denominator auditing rather than optimization.

upper_band_solve_rate.description: Solve rate on rows with difficulty at least 1.4, catching methods that only target the easiest visible cases.

difficulty_weighted_solve_rate.description: Difficulty-weighted solved fraction, rewarding gains that transfer across the harder part of the slice.

attempt_budget.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-attempt budget, a machine-independent search cost constraint.

rounds.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-construction rounds, penalizing larger search procedures.

timeout_seconds.description: Declared per-problem timeout budget, used as a resource cap rather than a wall-clock speed score.

neural_inference_used.description: Whether neural proposal inference was used; lower preserves the paper's non-neural search constraint.

jgex231_aux.description: Held-out JGEX-231 problems (AlphaGeometry's public benchmark) whose premises DDAR alone saturates without proving the goal; same protocol and budget as hageo409_aux. Smaller configurations make this the more discriminative scale-up of the same auxiliary-construction question.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of held-out problems proved within the attempt budget (pass@16), as verified by the evaluator's DDAR.

pass_auc.description: Mean over k=1..16 of pass@k: rewards proving problems with fewer attempts.

_weights_note: Equal experiment weights and a 0.25 coefficient on hageo409_aux.pass_auc: at the gym's scale every method proves only 1-3 of the 38 held-out HAGeo-409 problems, so that experiment resolves differences of about one problem (the reference's own seed spread) and its pass_auc is dominated by where a single solve falls; JGEX-231 shows the paper's effect well above seed noise.
